phase1_gate_analytical.verdict: REJECT ALL before synthesis. Every softmax-pass-reduction converges to the finish_token-limited floor ~5,895,425 cycles (gap 2.88x), only 1.057x (5.4%) better than prefix_opt2 and not a large approach to the 2,048,000 target. Per the Phase-1 gate, none is synthesized. finish_token/FFN is the co-bottleneck.
